answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 57 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a gale bet on surviving 57 epochs of grading, and every anchor settlement recomputes the dawn schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 23 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
